timeline.text: Welcome to Something for When You're Bored. I’ll guide you through each tapping point. At every point, you’ll hear a short phrase. Repeat it aloud, or quietly inside your head. Let’s begin.

timeline.ins: Begin tapping on the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I feel bored and restless right now.

timeline.ins: Now tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: I keep reaching for something to fill this moment.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: This stillness feels uncomfortable.

timeline.ins: Now tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I want to scroll, snack, or do anything but sit here.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body feels antsy and unsettled.

timeline.ins: Now tap under your nose.
timeline.say: Part of me thinks boredom means something is wrong.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: I can admit this restlessness is real.

timeline.ins: Now tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I notice how badly I want to escape this feeling.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: Sitting with nothing to do feels harder than it should.

timeline.text: Take one easy breath. Notice whether anything has shifted, even slightly. If nothing has changed yet, that’s completely okay. Keep breathing, and we’ll continue.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I can let this restlessness be here without acting on it.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: I don’t have to fill every quiet moment.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: This boredom isn’t an emergency.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I can let my mind wander instead of reaching for my phone.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body can settle even without something to do.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I’m allowed to just be, without a reason.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: This stillness can hold something too.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can notice the urge to distract myself without following it.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: I can let this moment pass at its own pace.

timeline.text: Take another slow breath. Notice what feels different now. You don’t need the feeling to disappear. See if there’s simply a little less pressure, or a little more choice in how you meet this moment.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I’m capable of sitting with stillness.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: I trust that this restlessness will pass on its own.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I’m allowed to do nothing for a while.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I can find something quietly interesting in this moment.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body can relax into having nowhere to be.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I’m learning that boredom isn’t dangerous.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: I can let this time be simple.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I’m allowed to rest without earning it.

timeline.ins: Finish under your arm.
timeline.say: I’m ready to let this moment be enough.

timeline.text: Let your hands rest, and take one full breath. Notice how you feel now, without needing to judge it. Thank you for taking this time for yourself. Carry this steadiness with you as you continue.
